build_docker_context: build a Docker context directory with a Dockerfile for an fbcode project
run_make_docker_context_cli: run the make_docker_context script to generate a Docker context from fbcode_builder_config.py
create_dockerfile_from_config: create a Dockerfile by reading fbcode_builder_config.py and rendering build steps
test_make_docker_context: test the make_docker_context function with a custom steps function and github project name
review_make_docker_context: review the make_docker_context function to understand Docker context directory creation and argument parsing
